case_name: Portfolio missing viewport + H1 + meta description

fixes.fix_explanation: This meta tag tells mobile browsers how to scale and display your page, ensuring proper responsiveness across all device sizes.
fixes.fix_location: Add after the <meta charset> tag in <head>

fixes.fix_explanation: Every page needs exactly one H1 heading that describes the main content; search engines use this to understand your page's primary topic.
fixes.fix_location: Add at the beginning of the <body> content, typically as the first heading

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Explore Jane Doe's UX design and illustration portfolio. Award-winning designer specializing in digital experiences and visual storytelling.">
fixes.fix_explanation: A meta description summarizes your page content in 120-160 characters and appears in search results, improving click-through rates.
